scope: Actual bundled pure single-pulse FamiTone2 SFX transcription and existing REMethods conversion branch, independent native records, retained terminal frame, exact source spans, timing/tuning/control bounds and nonmutation. No native mixing, pulse-phase, listening or whole-game equivalence claim.

results.name: Independent effects 0 and 1 become detached canonical single-pulse SFX with exact source identities
Every original frame retains actual control duty and volume instead of inferring a generic envelope
The native retained end frame sounds before the following canonical cut and silent padding
Original timers match existing canonical note tables and strict mode accepts only that measured claim
Raw command, pointer and frame-source spans retain exact source bytes and bounded physical provenance
Relocated and NROM32 native sources preserve canonical audio without a ROM name or hash allowlist
Trainer offset and relocated native stream references change provenance without changing SFX values
Pulse 2 register streams retain channel identity and leave pulse 1 untouched
Delay edits retain every held video frame and final end-frame mix without time quantization
Valid native duty, volume and timer edits change detached notes and report nearest tuning differences
Native clear-state mute allows unknown timers until explicit low and high writes precede audibility
A native zero-volume interval cuts the canonical channel and later initialization can restart it
Missing audible timer initialization is refused instead of inheriting unknown native RAM
Unsupported pulse envelope, length and timer control bits are explicit representability refusals
Multichannel original SFX and triangle or noise stream edits refuse without discarding a channel
Only statically known effect IDs are selectable and entirely muted effects do not invent notes
Pattern limits reserve a real terminal-cut row, including the 128-row maximum
Undeclared options, noninteger sizes, PAL and unsupported modes are refused atomically
Expected physical identity catches stale inputs while valid unrelated source edits require redecoding
Unknown drivers, malformed streams and oversized input never return partial canonical content
Single-frame command order uses final register values and retains a native terminal frame
Result and input ownership stay detached and CommonJS matches the actual browser implementation
Canonical AudioCompiler accepts the ordinary pattern-backed SFX and unchanged timer helper
Disclosure separates audible timing from native mixing, phase, unknown muted timers and triggers
Existing registry routes SFX through one profile with bounded source evidence and no active mutation
Registry SFX refusal preserves unsupported semantics, stale identity and option validation
Registry cancellation, work limits and result bounds preserve SFX source and application state
